retained_contract: Account sessions MUST be isolated. One renderer MUST NOT read or mutate another account's storage, cookies, encryption operations, or desktop state.
Navigation, new-window creation, external URL opening, and custom-protocol dispatch MUST use explicit allow/deny policy. Logging an invalid navigation is insufficient.

Main-process network fetches initiated by a renderer MUST resist SSRF, unsafe redirects, oversized responses, and unsupported protocols.
Local wrapper content MUST have a restrictive CSP without `unsafe-eval` in production.
Production packages MUST apply reviewed Electron fuses, code signing, and integrity controls supported by the target platform.
Security-sensitive failures MUST fail closed and produce useful, non-secret diagnostic information.
